spec.description:
Get started faster with Grafana Cloud then easily build these dashboards. https://grafana.com/products/cloud/
Overview of metrics from Prometheus 2.0.  
Useful for using prometheus to monitor your prometheus.
Revisions welcome!

spec.title: Average Rule Evaluation Duration
spec.description: The duration of rule group evaluations

spec.title: Total Series
spec.description: Total number of time series in prometheus

spec.title: Reload Failures [$interval]
spec.description: Number of times the database failed to reload block data from disk.

spec.title: Missed Iterations [$interval]
spec.description: The total number of rule group evaluations missed due to slow rule group evaluation.

spec.title: Skipped Iterations [$interval]
spec.description: The total number of rule group evaluations skipped due to throttled metric storage.

spec.title: Tardy Scrapes [$interval]
spec.description: Total number of scrapes that hit the sample limit and were rejected.

spec.title: Uptime [$interval]
spec.description: Percentage of uptime during the most recent $interval period.  Change the period with the 'interval' dropdown above.

spec.title: Target Sync
spec.description: Actual interval to sync the scrape pool.

spec.title: Currently Down
spec.description:
Servers which are DOWN RIGHT NOW! 
FIX THEM!!

spec.title: Rule Evaluator Iterations
spec.description:
Rule-group evaluations 
 - total
 - missed due to slow rule group evaluation
 - skipped due to throttled metric storage

spec.title: Appended Samples per Second
spec.description: Rate of total number of appended samples

spec.title: Scrape Sync Total
spec.description: Total number of syncs that were executed on a scrape pool.
